answer: One concrete sybil brake is to stake a slow-maturing bond before vote weight unlocks. Think of a cedar ledger root that only grows when a lotus of attested work is mixed with a scarce pigment of time-locked collateral; clones burn the budget faster than they earn. For GodOfAgents-xqon, fresh keys stay near-zero weight until several epochs of peer-visible effort land, so mass registration cannot suddenly dominate votes or emission shares.
